newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas will not stay at 10 pct of CLT - chief.
newsitem.headline: Havas will not stay at 10 pct of CLT - chief.

text.p: French communications company Havas will either increase its 10 percent stake in Cie Luxembourgoise de Television (CLT) or sell out altogether, Havas chairman Pierre Dauzier said on Friday.
He told a meeting of share analysts that Havas wanted only majority holdings in other companies.
"We cannot be satisfied with being a 10 percent shareholder (in CLT)... we cannot stay at the current level in the long term," he said.
However change could only come on this front after a contract between Havas's IP, which sells advertising space, and CLT's radio stations, primarily RTL, had reached its term in the year 2000.
"I am in the habit of respecting contracts... afterwards we could see (Havas) either increasing or disposing of its CLT capital," he said.
